universal_guidelines: ALWAYS use 'Barlow Condensed' for headings (h1, h2, h3). Import it in index.css.
Dark mode is the default and ONLY mode for this iteration. Do not implement light mode toggle unless requested.
All interactive elements MUST have a minimum touch target of 44x44px (mobile PWA rule).
Input fields on mobile should use type='tel' or 'number' where appropriate to trigger correct keyboards.
Ensure high contrast (WCAG AA) for all text. Light gray on black.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000) for backgrounds. Use Zinc-950 (#09090B).
All buttons must have 'active:scale-95' for tactile feedback.
The 'Scan QR' or 'New Ticket' button should be the most prominent element on the driver dashboard.

setup: Add the Google Fonts import to /app/frontend/src/index.css immediately.
Update tailwind.config.js to extend the font family theme with 'heading' (Barlow Condensed) and 'body' (Inter).
Create a 'Layout' component that enforces the mobile container width (max-w-md mx-auto) to simulate a mobile app on desktop screens.
